ai.method: 在gNB和AMF分别设置内外证书挑战，通过TPM PCR引用由核心网侧证明代理验证。利用gNB侧RRC转发门和AMF侧保存-重放机制，在不修改3GPP NAS消息结构的前提下插入多轮挑战-响应交换。基于srsRAN、srsUE和Open5GS在B210 USRP测试平台实现，UE配备硬件TPM 2.0。
ai.result: 原型成功阻止SIM移植、伪造证书、固件篡改和重放攻击。六次试验中，平均接入延迟从1886毫秒增加到2260毫秒，预认证开销为373.4毫秒，同时保留标准5G-AKA、安全模式和PDU会话流程。
ai.help_to_user: 该研究为5G设备认证提供了增强方案，可帮助理解如何在现有5G架构中集成硬件信任根和启动证明，以及评估其性能开销。

papers.title: Distributed Nash Equilibrium Seeking with Logarithmic Bit Rates over Digital Channels
papers.summary: This paper introduces quantization techniques to reduce the communication complexity in the distributed Nash equilibrium (NE) seeking problem, achieving an exponential reduction in bit rates over digital channels. The goal of distributed NE seeking algorithms is to coordinate agents in a network game toward equilibrium through iterative message exchanges among them via a communication network. The computational complexity of this distributed algorithm critically depends on network communication overhead in the digital channel, motivating the development of communication reduction mechanism. Regarding this, we proposed some quantizers based on sparsification and uniform quantization through a general class of ultimate-boundedness-based quantizers. Based on this, we propose a Passivity-Based NE seeking Algorithm with Time-varying scaling Error state Quantization (PBA-TEQ), and show that the linear convergence can be achieved under a sufficient condition. Moreover, when employing either the scalarization quantizer or the greedy quantizer, both belonging to the ultimate-boundedness-based quantizers, within the PBA-TEQ framework, we establish a lower bound on communication complexity of $\log_2(\mathcal{O}(nd))$ bit rates per transmission to achieve unbiased linear convergence, with $n$ being the number of agents and $d$ being the dimension of the decision state of the network game. Numerical simulation examples are provided to validate our theoretical results.

ai.tldr: 提出一种基于量化技术的分布式纳什均衡求解算法，将通信比特率指数级降低，同时保持线性收敛。

ai.result: 在充分条件下实现线性收敛，并证明采用标量化或贪心量化器时，每次传输的通信复杂度下界为log2(O(nd))比特，实现无偏线性收敛。

papers.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract
papers.summary: The dominant paradigm treats AI safety as a property to be instilled during model training via RLHF, DPO, or Constitutional AI. We argue this is structurally insufficient for autonomous agents that execute code, mutate files, send messages, and modify databases. Agent safety should be a runtime contract enforced by the harness, and the contract has two complementary faces. The preventive face blocks dangerous actions before they happen via sandboxes, permission gates, output filters, and trajectory monitors. The evidential face requires verifiable proof that good actions actually happened, gating task submission on hard evidence such as test runs, log captures, file diffs, and citation grounding. We ground the position in four lines of public evidence, with row-level protocols and data released in the supplementary JSON files: a survey of 52 documented AI-agent and LLM safety incidents, a false-completion audit with 31 non-contested core cases plus one disputed illustrative case, a trajectory-schema audit of 12 public agent systems and harnesses, and a title-level audit of all 28,560 papers accepted at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR 2023-2025 showing a pooled 8-12x imbalance between training-time and deployment-time publication. Two prior communities that needed to enforce safety, computer security and the experimental sciences, converged on runtime contracts with both preventive and evidential elements; agentic AI is now under the same pressure. We formalize an Agent Trajectory Schema and Evidence Chain, state a compositional gating proposition based on standard monitor composition, and outline a research agenda. The right unit of safety in agentic AI is the trajectory-with-checkable-evidence, not the model.

ai.tldr: 本文主张智能体安全应作为运行时契约，由执行环境强制实施，而非仅依赖训练阶段的对齐。
ai.motivation: 现有AI安全主要依赖训练时的RLHF、DPO等方法，但对执行代码、修改文件、发送消息的自主智能体而言，这种范式结构性不足。
ai.method: 通过调查52起安全事件、31起虚假完成案例、12个智能体系统的轨迹模式审计，以及28,560篇论文的标题级审计，论证运行时契约的必要性，并提出智能体轨迹模式与证据链。
ai.result: 发现训练时与部署时安全研究的出版数量存在8-12倍的不平衡，支持运行时契约的论点。
ai.help_to_user: 帮助理解智能体安全需要从训练时转向运行时，并提供了具体的审计数据和形式化框架。

idea_spark.idea: 设计一个智能体运行时环境，强制要求每个动作附带可验证的证据，如测试结果、日志或文件差异。
idea_spark.risk: 可能增加系统开销，且证据生成可能被绕过或伪造。
idea_spark.inspiration: 借鉴计算机安全和实验科学中的运行时契约思想，为智能体安全提供新视角。

en.tldr: This paper argues that agent safety should be a runtime contract enforced by the harness, not just a training-time property.
en.motivation: Current AI safety relies on training-time alignment (RLHF, DPO, etc.), which is structurally insufficient for autonomous agents that execute code and modify systems.
en.method: The authors ground their position with surveys of 52 incidents, 31 false-completion cases, audits of 12 agent systems, and a title-level audit of 28,560 papers, and propose an Agent Trajectory Schema and Evidence Chain.
en.result: They find an 8-12x imbalance between training-time and deployment-time safety publications, supporting the need for runtime contracts.
en.help_to_user: This helps understand why agent safety must shift from training to runtime, with concrete evidence and a formal framework.

idea_spark.idea: Design a runtime environment that requires each agent action to be accompanied by verifiable evidence, such as test results or logs.
idea_spark.risk: Potential overhead and risk of evidence forgery or bypass.
idea_spark.inspiration: Drawing from computer security and experimental sciences, this offers a new perspective on agent safety.
